featured_reviews.name: Sam Samy
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a genuinely frustrating experience at this electronic shop and wouldn’t recommend it to anyone. The owner was dismissive from the moment I walked in, acting impatient when I asked basic questions about the warranty and product specs. I ended up purchasing a laptop that developed hardware issues within three weeks, and when I went back for support he refused to honor the warranty, claiming it was “user damage” without even inspecting the device. He raised his voice instead of offering a solution and tried to push me ❌toward an overpriced repair service at his own workshop. The billing was also unclear, with hidden charges that weren’t mentioned at the time of purchase. On top of that, the staff seemed untrained and there was zero accountability when I asked for a manager. For a place that advertises “customer first service,” the reality is the exact opposite. Save yourself the headache and buy electronics somewhere that values honesty over a quick sale. The shop should be ban 😡😡 I will not recommend this shop to anyone....
